subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c1e563879b5791e256ecfda57e262b779edbad90d53437466cdb3f9e35ead27.png] 

How many such interior decorators are there who are NEITHER architects NOR dancers?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afae0d7903c35bc65dd8a896f467ebb3d93109c3863efa4ce74fd21f6104f8e8.png] 

The shaded area shows the interior decorators are there who are NEITHER architects NOR dancers.

So, there are '150' interior decorators are there who are NEITHER architects NOR dancers.

Hence, the correct answer is **"150"**.
